patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width dark backgrounds and slightly lighter dark backgrounds, with content constrained to a central max-width container.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text.
A dark, deep blue/purple and charcoal grey color scheme dominates, providing a high-contrast backdrop for white text and vibrant green call-to-action elements.
The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background code editor graphic moves slower than the foreground text as the user scrolls.
Content sections animate into view with a fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reveal experience.
The primary navigation bar transforms from transparent with white text to a sticky, solid dark background with adjusted text color after scrolling past the hero section.
Product features and benefits are consistently illustrated with dark-themed, glowing UI screenshots or mockups, often embedded within a device frame or abstract container.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a large background image or video that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax depth effect.
A sticky navigation bar is implemented that changes its background color and text styling from transparent to solid dark once the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by locomotive-scroll, reveal new content sections by fading them up or sliding them into view as they enter the user's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual anchors, with body text being clear and legible. Labels and secondary text are smaller and lighter.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (small radius) are consistently applied to buttons, input fields, and card-like UI elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing throughout most content sections, with a notably airy hero section that provides ample breathing room around the primary message.

standout: The site's distinctive use of dark, glowing, code editor-themed UI elements and product screenshots as a pervasive visual language creates an immersive, high-tech, and sophisticated aesthetic that goes beyond typical product showcases.
